card.name: The letter Z starting a name
card.fires_on: The letter Z (or z) at the start of a new word or name, such as a brand, surname, file system or place. Also fires on a q after a slash in a DOI.

modes.label: Z beginning a name
modes.description: A capital Z begins a proper name, brand or title, often after a space, ampersand or colon.

modes.label: Z in drug or code terms
modes.description: A lowercase or capital z begins a drug name, code or URL part.
modes.example: diazepam estazolam flurazepam buspirone<< z>>olpidem ↑ sedatives/hyp

card.writes: No clear meaning; it mostly nudges rare name pieces such as odiac and unker.
card.plain: It lights up when a new word or name begins with the letter Z.
